lenses.smells_idioms: ps_renderer -> ps_net -> ps_sparks provides renderer/window and typed sparkNet/sparkRun through inherited properties. lenses.glsl: Vertex output locations 0/1 match fragment tc/colour; gl_VertexIndex expands six vertices per particle. Constants SLOTS/PER/DUST partition the draw and must agree with Kotlin allocation.
lenses.live_coding: No //%- markers or declaration/reset pairs. loop advances deterministic frames at an assumed sixty Hz, as the transcript description states.
